segments.text:
V. 25.
His mother's ſiſter—But we do not read ſhe had any Brother. She was her Father's Heir, and as ſuch tranſmitted the Right of the Kingdom of David to Jeſus: Mary the wiſe of Cleopas—Called likewiſe Alpheus, the Father, as Mary was the Mother of James, and J•ſ•s, and Simon, and Judas.
